facts.heading: Wife suggested therapy
facts.content: Tomas's wife suggested he seek therapy because things 'can't go on like this'.
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove 30 times.
facts.evidence: I check 30 times if I locked the door and turned off the stove.

facts.heading: Time spent leaving apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour to leave the apartment.
facts.evidence: It takes me an hour before I leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Anxiety triggers fire images
facts.content: When checking, Tomas feels anxious and sees an image of burning.
facts.evidence: I get anxious. Then an image comes to my head that I didn't do it properly and I have to burn.

facts.heading: Fire images seen daily
facts.content: Tomas sees the image of being in flames every day.
facts.evidence: Being in flames. I see it clearly like a film.

facts.heading: Anxiety peaks in evenings
facts.content: The anxiety is worst in the evening when going out or sleeping, and in the morning too.
facts.evidence: It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep. And in the morning too.

facts.heading: Onset linked to neighbor's fire
facts.content: The issue started two years ago after the neighbor's house caught fire and they evacuated.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbor's house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Experience of neighbor's fire
facts.content: During the fire, Tomas saw the neighbor's house burn from outside.
facts.evidence: I stood outside in the yard and watched the window burn.

facts.heading: Belief of causing disaster
facts.content: Since the fire, Tomas feels he can cause it if he doesn't control something and will be responsible.
facts.evidence: At that time, I have the feeling that I can cause it. That if I don't control something, it will happen and I will be responsible.

facts.heading: Anxiety symptoms during struggle
facts.content: When trying to stop the behavior, Tomas experiences anxiety growing until he feels like he is going crazy.
facts.evidence: Then anxiety grows in me, until I feel like I'm going crazy.

facts.heading: Physical anxiety manifestations
facts.content: Tomas experiences his heart pounding and stomach feeling bad when anxious.
facts.evidence: My heart pounded in my hand and my stomach felt bad.

facts.heading: Wife is aware of issue
facts.content: Tomas's wife, Barbara, knows about the issue.
facts.evidence: Barbara. My wife.

facts.heading: Wife's perception of issue
facts.content: Barbara now sees that Tomas's behavior is more than just a habit.
facts.evidence: At first she took it as a habit, now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Late arrival at cinema
facts.content: Tomas arrived at the cinema 40 minutes late yesterday.
facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema 40 minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction to delay
facts.content: Barbara waited outside for Tomas and noticed the stove was off after the third check.
facts.evidence: She waited outside for me to come back and the stove was off after the third.

facts.heading: Feeling like a child
facts.content: Tomas felt like a child who can't leave the house after the incident at the cinema.
facts.evidence: I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.heading: Works as an electrician in Malomolec
facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Malomolec.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Malomolec

facts.heading: Worries about making mistakes
facts.content: Tomas worries that he might make a mistake while working.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head, I might make a mistake

facts.heading: Performs follow-up on jobs
facts.content: Tomas goes back to ongoing jobs to look at them on the second day.
facts.evidence: But I go back for follow-up on ongoing jobs.

facts.heading: Boss calls him careful
facts.content: Tomas's boss tells him he is the most careful in the company.
facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company

facts.heading: Work slowing down recently
facts.content: In the last few months, Tomas's work has slowed down by an hour per day.
facts.evidence: In the last few months, the work has slowed down by an hour per day

facts.heading: Fears losing his job
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he will lose his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Partner is pregnant in fourth month
facts.content: Tomas's partner, Probora, is pregnant in the fourth month.
facts.evidence: Probora is pregnant in the fourth month.

facts.heading: Waited three years for child
facts.content: Tomas and his partner waited for a child for three years.
facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years

facts.heading: Intrusive thoughts about harm
facts.content: Tomas has thoughts that might harm his partner and the baby.
facts.evidence: That it might harm her and the baby.

facts.heading: Thoughts occur while cutting bread
facts.content: The thought of harm comes to Tomas when he is cutting bread on the landing.
facts.evidence: But the thought comes when I'm cutting bread on the landing

facts.heading: Keeps thoughts secret from Barbora
facts.content: Tomas has not told anyone about these thoughts, not even Barbora.
facts.evidence: It's the worst when I haven't told anyone. Not even Barbora.

facts.heading: Thoughts are slow to believe
facts.content: Tomas states that it takes time until he believes the intrusive thoughts.
facts.evidence: It would be slowly. Still, it takes time until I believe it.

facts.heading: Coping mechanism is leaving room
facts.content: When a thought appears, Tomas leaves the room.
facts.evidence: I leave the room.

facts.heading: Coping mechanism is checking
facts.content: Tomas sometimes checks something to make the intrusive thought stop.
facts.evidence: Or I come back and check something to make it stop.

facts.heading: Sleep is intermittent
facts.content: Tomas sleeps intermittently and gets up twice at night.
facts.evidence: I sleep intermittently. I get up twice at night

facts.heading: Walking helps keep busy
facts.content: Tomas and Barbara go for walks when there is something at home to keep him busy.
facts.evidence: We go for walks with Barbara when there is something at home.

facts.heading: Walks happen twice weekly
facts.content: Tomas and Barbara go for walks twice a week, more or less.
facts.evidence: Walks twice. A week. Well, more or less.

facts.heading: Goal is to leave woods
facts.content: Tomas's goal is to leave the woods in five minutes.
facts.evidence: To leave the woods in five minutes.

facts.heading: Goal is child without thoughts
facts.content: Tomas hopes to look forward to a child without having those thoughts.
facts.evidence: And to look forward to a child without those thoughts.

facts.heading: Fear of exposure therapy
facts.content: Tomas was afraid of therapy where a person gradually exposes themselves to what they are afraid of.
facts.evidence: I was afraid of that.

facts.heading: Fear of being forced
facts.content: Tomas feared someone would force him to leave the door open.
facts.evidence: I thought someone would force me to leave the door open.

facts.heading: Difficulty with small steps
facts.content: Tomas finds even small steps to be big for him.
facts.evidence: It sounds small, but it is big for me.

facts.heading: Feelings for Barbora
facts.content: Tomas told the therapist that he loves Barbora and has not lost his interest in her.
facts.evidence: That I love her. And that I haven't lost my interest in her.

facts.heading: Fear of Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas is afraid that Barbora would not want to be with him.
facts.evidence: Right now I'm afraid she wouldn't want to be with me.

facts.heading: Expectation of Barbora's response
facts.content: Tomas expects Barbora to hug him.
facts.evidence: She would hug me.

facts.heading: Decision regarding Barbora
facts.content: Tomas decided not to discuss his thoughts about Barbora further at this time.
facts.evidence: That's enough. Not about those thoughts yet.

facts.heading: Trying door check once
facts.content: Tomas agreed to try checking the door just once when leaving the apartment.
facts.evidence: Once. I'll try it.

facts.heading: Writing down a number
facts.content: Tomas plans to write down a number from one to ten.
facts.evidence: And I'll write down a number from one to ten.
